params.name: assetId
params.description: Specify a single asset ID to fetch

params.name: assetIDs
params.description: Specify multiple asset IDs to fetch. Response type will be a list

params.name: createdBy
params.description: Filters asset lists by the user who created them. The user is specified by their identity subject

params.name: keyword
params.description:
Matches assets where their name or description contains the specified keyword.
This is a list query parameter, and cannot be used with any primary query parameters

params.name: searchSemantic
params.description:
BETA: Semantic search using vector similarity to find assets by meaning.
Use this for "images of mountains" style queries.
Requires AI credits.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of records to return

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sets the sorting of the results. If unspecified, results are sorted by creation date ascending.
Allowed values are: updated_at_DESC, updated_at_ASC, created_at_DESC, created_at_ASC, name_DESC, name_ASC, slug_DESC, slug_ASC, relevance_DESC (when searching).

params.name: facetBy
params.description: Returns counts for distinct values of the specified field or fields (provided as comma-separated IDs).

params.name: projectId
params.description: The project the asset/assets are on

params.name: type
params.description: The asset type ID to filter by

params.name: updatedBy
params.description: Filters asset lists by the user who last updated them. The user is specified by their identity subject

params.name: withTotalCount
params.description:
Controls whether the total count of results will be returned along with the current results page in a list.
Has no effect when not fetching a list. This does impact performance when enabled

params.name: releaseId
params.description:
The ID of a release to fetch the content for.

- When unspecified, all release content is excluded from the result(s).
- When specified, all content is returned as it would appear in the release if it was released now. This includes both content copied to the release and changed, as well as content that is not part of the release.

Content copied to a release can be differentiated from base content by the `releaseId` property on the content. If the content is not copied to the release, this property will be undefined

params.name: withAssignedLabels
params.description:
When true, includes full label entities in the response for UI rendering.
The assignedLabels array includes the label and its parent group (if any).
This parameter is not supported with uniform.global.

params.name: withUIStatus
params.description:
Returns additional author and creator metadata for the asset.
This internal status is subject to change without notice and is thus marked deprecated to discourage use of internal data

items.docs:
In addition to the named parameters below, this endpoint accepts the
following query parameter convention which is pattern-validated and
therefore not declared as named parameters:

* `filters.<field>[<op>]` — content filtering (documented below).

#### Content filtering (`filters.*`)

Filtering narrows list results to assets matching field values. The
allowed field names are project-specific — they come from the project's
asset definitions — which is why `filters.*` parameters are
pattern-valid
Handles preflight requests. This endpoint allows CORS
